items.title: Construction of Photovoltaic Parksdqwdqw
items.body: Solar is an abundant and cheap source of energy in South Africa. For customers with existing on-site solar panels, the addition of wheeled solar can boost renewable energy penetration by up to 50%, without the need for capital expenditure.dqwdwqdwqdqwdqw

items.title: Construction of Wind Parksdwqdqwdwqdqw
items.body: Wind power, an intermittent resource with high potential in South Africa, generates power primarily during the mornings and evenings, perfectly complementing solar. A blend of off-site solar and wind energy can potentially elevate renewable energy penetration by an additional 15-20%.dwqdqwdqwd

items.title: Solar PV Systemsdqwdwqdwqdqw
items.body:
Enpower Trading leverages the Eskom and Municipal networks to provide customers with a choice of energy source.

As the market evolves, Enpower Trading will collaborate with municipalities, regulators and other bodies to ensure municipalities remain revenue surplus neutral, and that we collectively work toward the goals of South Africa's Just Energy Transition: decarbonisation, affordability and security of supply.dwqdwqdqw

items.title: Data Center Constructiondqwdqwdqwdq
items.body:
South African customers have limited access to Renewable Energy (RE) and can only supply a small percentage of their total energy needs through on-site generation. On-site generation requires high capital expenditure, and can only power one location.

Enpower Trading offers customers access to a wide range of energy sources that collectively provide up to 100% renewable energy penetration rate, across multiple sites, reducing reliance on non-renewable energy ('brown power').

Customers now have the ability to choose the source of their energy.dqwdqwdqw

items.title: Maintenancedqwdqwdqw
items.body: Maximize your savings with our competitive tariffs and journey towards a net-zero future with the guidance of our Team. Enjoy the freedom of no longer being reliant on a single utility and benefit from fixed escalations, flexible contract periods (5, 10, or 20 years) as well as Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) which assist you on your journey to net-zero.
items.footnote: Between 2007 and 2022 the Eskom Tariff increased by 653%.dqwdqwdqw

items.title: Construction Services, Inspections & Testingdqwdqwdqwd
items.body: The evolved future trading market will transform the way in which we purchase and consume energy. The future liberalized market will see the unbundling of the previous vertically integrated national utility, allowing for a more competitive energy market and greener future.dqwdqwdqwdqwd

posts.title: Inside the 300 MW Butimanu development
posts.excerpt: A closer look at the people, planning and field coordination behind one of Romania's largest photovoltaic developments.
posts.alt: Field operations at the Butimanu photovoltaic development
posts.intro: GreenTech Professionals is contributing electrical and mechanical installation capability to the 300 MW photovoltaic development in Butimanu, Romania.

sections.title: Scale requires coordination
paragraphs: A project of this size brings together technical decisions, site logistics and a large field workforce. More than 200 skilled professionals were reported on site, supported by a dedicated management team.
Daily coordination keeps electrical and mechanical activities aligned while work advances across a large and active construction area.

sections.title: Delivery in the field
paragraphs: The execution scope combines photovoltaic assembly, cable routing and electrical installation. Each stage depends on clear sequencing, consistent checks and communication between teams.
Butimanu also reflects GreenTech Professionals' continued growth in the Romanian renewable energy market.
